title: Custom Trucking Semi Truck Breaking Through Stone Wall Comforter design 2
description:
Add a powerful and personalized touch to your bedroom decor with this custom trucker comforter set by Jeminise. Featuring a dynamic digital illustration of a semi truck breaking through a stone wall, this bedding set is perfect for truck drivers and vehicle enthusiasts alike. Personalize it with your custom name text to create a truly unique gift or a bold focal point for your own space.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Features a custom name text input option to make your trucker bedding truly one-of-a-kind.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric that is soft, breathable, and lightweight, mimicking the comfort of cotton.
  • Durable Quality: Utilizes advanced environmental protection dyeing techniques that hold color and prevent fading, finished with compact edge stitching.
  • Included Components: Your choice of a Duvet Cover or Comforter with optional matching pillowcases.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; tumble dry on low heat and air dry without heat for quick, fluffy results.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Color Cool Black Truck
Pattern Cartoon
Style Modern
Theme Trucker
Seasons All
Customization 1 text input
Care Instructions Machine Wash
